steps.title: Read OpenCV measurements
steps.detail: OpenCV 5.0.0 measured hi-vis coverage 6.8% across 1 orange contours, 1 panel-shaped regions, and 0 yellow or red placard regions.

steps.title: Measure the panel interior
steps.detail: Interior edge density is 10.5%, above the 8% open-gear threshold. The cover is treated as off.

steps.title: Check the jobsite policy
steps.detail: Critical rule fired. Next action is an urgent office ticket, then an SMS that quotes the ticket.

rules.detail: Exposed electrical parts. Work around live gear stops until a qualified person guards or de-energizes it.
No yellow or red warning placard beside the equipment.

steps.title: Open an urgent office ticket
steps.detail: Created FS-203F because policy.check returned ESCALATE.

output.title: Electrical exposure on a plumbing call
output.summary: Hi-vis vest is in frame. The panel reads open and no warning label was found.

steps.title: Draft the text
steps.detail: Drafted a ESCALATE text to office-oncall. The wording comes from the policy branch, not a fixed script.

output.body: FieldSight ESCALATE (INS-6F5B18E9). Ticket FS-203F. Open electrical gear on a plumbing call. Vest is on. Warning label is missing. Stop the plumbing work and get a qualified electrical person.

steps.title: Write the clearance note
steps.detail: The note records the measurements and which tools the branch actually ran.
